passages.title: Debate Team: Finding a Quiet Room
passages.text: On Monday, the school debate team met in the library. Because the auditorium was being repaired, the students needed a quieter room. During the first hour, they collected evidence about public transport. When the teacher arrived, the students compared their arguments. Despite the limited time, they completed a short outline. Although several members disagreed, everyone listened respectfully. After the discussion ended, the team shared its draft with the teacher.

passages.title: A Student Improves Her Science Project
passages.text: During the science fair, a student explained her air-quality project. Although the first sensor was unreliable, she kept collecting observations. She revised the design after her teacher suggested a simpler circuit. Because the new sensor worked better, the class could compare readings from different rooms. Despite the extra work, the student finished her report before the deadline. When the exhibition opened, visitors asked how she had checked her results.

questions.prompt: Which expression is an adverbial phrase of place?
questions.explanation: [[Near the entrance]] merupakan frasa keterangan tempat; hanya mengandung kata depan dan kelompok nomina.

translationId.prompt: Ungkapan mana yang merupakan frasa adverbial tempat?

questions.prompt: Which expression contains a subject and a finite verb?
questions.explanation: [[After the lesson ended]] memiliki subjek [[the lesson]] dan verba finit [[ended]], jadi merupakan klausa.

translationId.prompt: Ungkapan mana yang memiliki subjek dan verba finit?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct completion: “The match was delayed ___ the rain.”
questions.explanation: Di belakang bagian kosong terdapat frasa nomina [[the rain]], sehingga [[because of]] sesuai. [[Because]] membutuhkan klausa pada pola ini.

translationId.prompt: Pilih pelengkap yang benar: “Pertandingan ditunda ___ hujan.”

choices: Although the traffic, we arrived early.
Although of the rain, we walked.
Although the road was busy, we arrived early.
questions.explanation: [[Although the road was busy]] memuat subjek [[the road]] dan verba finit [[was]]. Pilihan lain menggunakan frasa tanpa klausa.

translationId.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai “although” dengan benar?
choices: Meskipun lalu lintas, kami tiba lebih awal (struktur keliru).
Meskipun karena hujan, kami berjalan (struktur keliru).
Walaupun jalan ramai, kami tiba lebih awal (struktur benar).

questions.prompt: In the first passage, which expression is an adverbial clause of reason?
choices: Because the auditorium was being repaired
questions.explanation: Bagian [[Because the auditorium was being repaired]] menerangkan alasan dan memiliki subjek [[the auditorium]] serta verba finit [[was being repaired]].

translationId.prompt: Dalam bacaan pertama, ungkapan mana yang merupakan klausa adverbial alasan?

questions.evidence: Because the auditorium was being repaired

questions.prompt: In the first passage, which expression is an adverbial phrase of time?
questions.explanation: [[During the first hour]] adalah frasa: kata depan [[during]] diikuti frasa nomina. Pilihan lain memiliki subjek dan verba finit.

translationId.prompt: Dalam bacaan pertama, ungkapan mana yang merupakan frasa adverbial waktu?

questions.prompt: What is the grammatical role of “Although several members disagreed” in the first passage?
choices: A main clause giving an instruction
A noun phrase describing the team
questions.explanation: [[Although several members disagreed]] adalah klausa keterangan pertentangan. [[Several members]] subjek, [[disagreed]] verba finit.

translationId.prompt: Apa peran gramatikal ungkapan tersebut dalam bacaan pertama?

questions.prompt: Which clause could replace “Despite the limited time” while keeping the contrast?
questions.explanation: [[Although time was limited]] menyatakan pertentangan dengan klausa finit (subjek [[time]], verba [[was]]). Ini mempertahankan hubungan makna [[despite]].

translationId.prompt: Klausa mana yang dapat menggantikan “Despite the limited time” sambil mempertahankan makna pertentangan?

questions.prompt: Which expression from the second passage is an adverbial clause of reason?
choices: Because the new sensor worked better
questions.explanation: [[Because the new sensor worked better]] memuat subjek [[the new sensor]] dan verba finit [[worked]], sehingga merupakan klausa keterangan alasan.

translationId.prompt: Ungkapan mana dari bacaan kedua yang merupakan klausa adverbial alasan?
choices: Karena sensor baru berfungsi lebih baik

questions.evidence: Because the new sensor worked better

questions.prompt: What type of adverbial is “Despite the extra work” in the second passage?
questions.explanation: [[Despite the extra work]] adalah frasa keterangan pertentangan; [[the extra work]] merupakan frasa nomina, bukan subjek + verba finit.

translationId.prompt: Jenis adverbial apa “Despite the extra work” pada bacaan kedua?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct completion: “___ the teacher was explaining, the students took notes.”
questions.explanation: [[The teacher was explaining]] adalah klausa, sehingga [[while]] sesuai untuk menandai waktu berlangsung. [[During]] diikuti frasa nomina.

translationId.prompt: Pilih pelengkap yang benar: “___ guru sedang menjelaskan, siswa mencatat.”

questions.prompt: Which explanation correctly identifies the adverbial in “After dinner, Sari reviewed the notes”?
choices: “After dinner” is a clause because “reviewed” is a verb.
“Sari reviewed” is an adverbial phrase of time.
“After dinner” is a clause because every sentence has a subject.
“After dinner” is a phrase because it has no subject–finite verb pair of its own.
questions.explanation: Periksa bagian [[after dinner]] saja. Frasa itu tidak memiliki subjek atau verba finit sendiri. Subjek [[Sari]] dan verba [[reviewed]] berada di klausa utama.

translationId.prompt: Penjelasan mana yang benar untuk adverbial dalam kalimat tersebut?
choices: “After dinner” adalah klausa karena “reviewed” adalah verba (keliru).
“After dinner” adalah klausa karena tiap kalimat memiliki subjek (keliru).
“After dinner” adalah frasa karena tidak memiliki pasangan subjek–verba finit sendiri.
